Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 42 (TierPoint missing-address campaign): added a tier-1 operator sourced address from this facilitys own dedicated page, traced and dated the companys Argo Infrastructure Partners ownership and its own January 2025 acquisition by Apollo Global Management, which the registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. research_status remains complete.

[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] TierPoint provides colocation, cloud, and managed IT services from a portfolio the company and its majority owner describe as roughly 40 data centers across about 18 to 20 U.S. markets. This session traced and dated the companys ownership structure, previously recorded without a clear citation chain: institutional investor Argo Infrastructure Partners began investing in TierPoint in 2020, added a further 500 million dollars in 2022, and took a majority stake by 2024. Per Argos own December 9, 2025 press release, Argo then acquired the equity interests of most of TierPoints remaining minority shareholders, consolidating its control and bringing total capital formation under Argos ownership to 3 billion dollars since 2020. Separately, per Data Center Dynamics trade press, Apollo Global Management announced in January 2025 that it would acquire Argo Infrastructure Partners itself, adding about 6 billion dollars in assets to Apollos infrastructure platform, with closing expected in the second quarter of 2025, meaning Argos majority stake in TierPoint now sits within Apollos broader infrastructure platform. This specific row, TierPoint Sioux Falls West, per the operators own dedicated page for this facility, fetched fresh this session, sits at 5300 North La Mesa Drive, Sioux Falls, SD 57107, internally coded SFW. A DataCenterMap listing for this same facility uses the URL slug cosentry-la-mesa, consistent with the Data Center Dynamics trade press coverage fetched this session confirming TierPoint acquired this and other Midwest facilities through its January 2016 purchase of Cosentry.
